why: The seam between the browser client and ui.js, pinned from BOTH sides against these literals.
The frontend suite stubs fetch and the node suite drives a real socket, so neither can
see the two disagreeing: the client could build /api/projects/x/behaviour/ID/steps
(singular) and both suites would stay green — one over its own stub, the other over its
own hand-typed path. A green suite over a mock proves the mock.
So the paths and bodies below are written down ONCE. client.test.ts asserts the client
emits exactly these; kit.test.js feeds exactly these to a running ui.js and asserts the
file on disk changed. Drift on either side turns one of them red.

corpus.gamma.beh:
# a comment that must survive
behaviour BEH-G "gamma"
  actor engineer
  when opens page:Home
corpus.two words.beh:
behaviour BEH-W "spaced"
  actor engineer
  when opens page:Home

requests.what: add one step to a behaviour that exists
add a whole new behaviour, actor included
an app name that has to survive the URL, and a behaviour id that does too
a step the grammar refuses — the corpus must be untouched and the reason must travel
